metadata.title: ELIXIR - Protein-Protein Interface Benchmark - OpenEBench Experiment
metadata.description:
OpenEBench implementation of the ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo benchmark for discriminating physiological from crystallographic (non-physiological) protein homodimer interfaces: schema-validated OpenEBench metadata (Community, Benchmarking Event, Challenge, Metrics, Tools, Contacts), the datasets of 14 reference scoring methods (13 research groups and a random-forest consensus), the gold-standard labels, four homology-aware cross-validation fold assignments, the benchmark workflow scripts (validation, metric computation, consolidation), and a static web page that evaluates new predictions in the browser and ranks them against the reference methods.

The benchmark has 1,671 entries (840 physiological and 831 non-physiological): the 1,677 entries of the curated annotation of the benchmark authors, without the six entries flagged for deletion. The labels are those of the curated annotation, which differs for 16 entries from the original publication (Schweke et al. 2023, Proteomics 23(17):e2200323, doi:10.1002/pmic.202200323; 836 physiological and 841 non-physiological interfaces). The scores of the 13 research groups are those submitted to the original benchmark repository; the random-forest consensus uses the leave-one-out probabilities provided there.

Interactive page: https://elixir.unibo.it/tools/oeb_3dbioinfo_ppi_benchmark/. Please cite the original publication as well as this package.
